slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Fixed scan order slot 0,1,2 in FUN_0800dea4. Header status u32 at +0x10: 0=empty, 1=valid, -1=invalid. No backup copy, no generation counter.

slots_and_copies.name: global_config
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy at 0x1980 (header 0x80) + payload at 0x1A00 (0xE0 used of 0x600 reserved). Loaded by FUN_0800d8c4 at boot; factory-reset by FUN_0800d838 on any failure. No fallback copy.

checksums.name: global_payload_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: h=0xAA55A5A5; for each byte b in RAM order (after reversing each 8-byte file block): h=rol32(h,1)+b mod 2^32. FUN_08087c68. Stored u32 LE at header +0x0C. Covered: 0xE0-byte payload at EEPROM 0x1A00.

checksums.name: slot_payload_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_08087c68 rotate-left/add hash, seed 0xAA55A5A5, over 0x800-byte slot payload at slot*0x880+0x80. Stored u32 LE at slot header +0x0C. No occupied slot in samples, so unverified on bytes.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 primitive to 0x0D000000 via 0x040000D4; polls busy bit 0x8000.
EEPROM read: command bitstream DMA out, 0x44 halfwords DMA in, MSB-first pack into 8 bytes.
EEPROM write: write bitstream with 64 data bits; polls EEPROM ready bit with timeout.
Verify-after-write: re-reads block and compares 4 halfwords; returns 0x8000 on mismatch.
Single-block write wrapper; skips when EEPROM type word == 0x200.
Retried block write: up to 3 write+verify attempts. Called by FUN_0808bce8 (indirect, not in callgraph).
Block read loop: block addr = (offset>>3)+index, RAM ptr += 8 per block.
Block write loop over FUN_08090ca8 per 8-byte block.
Guarded read entry; returns -1 if EEPROM-present flag is 0.
Guarded write entry; returns -1 if EEPROM-present flag is 0.
rol32(h,1)+byte hash, seed 0xAA55A5A5 (recovered by inversion, identical for both samples).
Global factory reset: defaults, magic, checksum, write header 0x1980 + payload 0x1A00.
Global save. No caller found in callgraph or text search (unrecovered jump table/function pointer) - named gap.
Global load: magic strcmp, status<2, checksum over 0xE0, then RAM clamps.
Slot create/erase: writes only the 0x80 header at slot*0x880; may refresh global block.
Slot load: magic, status, 12-byte mirror memcmp, 5 summary compares, checksum over 0x800.

fields.name: header_magic
fields.update_mechanism: strcpy (FUN_08086af4->FUN_080929f8) on every header write; strcmp==0 (FUN_08086b48->FUN_0809299c) required on load. Present at file offsets 0, 0x880, 0x1100, 0x1980.
fields.evidence: Decompiled strcpy/strcmp call sites plus identical bytes in all 4 headers of both .sav files.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed by FUN_08087c68 over payload on every save; compared on load. Offset is header-relative; add header base (0/0x880/0x1100/0x1980).
fields.evidence: Python verification: computed equals stored on both global payloads with seed 0xAA55A5A5. Slot coverage CONFIRMED_STATIC only.

fields.name: header_status
fields.update_mechanism: 0=empty written by FUN_0800db98; 1=valid written by savers; -1 set only in RAM by loaders on failure.
fields.evidence: Code writes/comparisons plus observed values in both files.

fields.name: header_reserved_08
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed for slots by FUN_0800db98; no traced reader. In file order its bytes interleave with the checksum due to 8-byte block reversal.
fields.evidence: Static write only; occupied-global value unexplained.

fields.name: slot_header_summary_18
fields.update_mechanism: Mirrors slot payload bytes +5, +4, u16@+0x34, byte +0x36, i8 vs payload i32@+0xD0. Zeroed on erase; real-save writer not recovered.

fields.name: slot_header_mirror_20
fields.update_mechanism: Mirror of slot payload +0x40..+0x4B, compared via func_0x08092af0 (probable memcmp). Only first byte zeroed on erase.
fields.evidence: Call shape in FUN_0800dd30; callee body absent from decompilation.

fields.name: slot_payload
fields.update_mechanism: Offset is slot-relative (add slot*0x880). No slot-payload writer recovered. Checksum-covered (0x800 bytes).
fields.evidence: Only loader and checksum coverage are known.

fields.name: global_payload_field_00
fields.update_mechanism: Set from ROM literal at factory reset; sole payload field changed between captures (file diff at 0x1A06..0x1A07 maps here after block reversal).
fields.evidence: Byte diff plus checksum update verified on both files. Meaning unknown.

fields.name: global_payload_field_02
fields.update_mechanism: Default 1 at factory reset; signed-clamped to 0..2 in RAM on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800d838 write and FUN_0800d8c4 clamp code.

fields.name: global_payload_field_04
fields.update_mechanism: Default 0xC0; refreshed from ROM literal by global saver; clamped 0..0x100 on load (exact clamp-offset mapping via pointer arithmetic is best-supported, not certain).

fields.name: global_payload_field_08
fields.update_mechanism: Default 0x100; refreshed by global saver; clamped 0..0x100 on load.

fields.name: global_payload_field_CC
fields.update_mechanism: Written 0 at factory reset (u16-pointer offset 0x66); checksum-covered only.

open_questions: No caller of the global saver FUN_0800e2a8 exists in ghidra/callgraph.json or as a text call in ghidra/decompiled.c; its trigger (menu action, autosave point) is unknown (likely an unrecovered jump table / function pointer).
No slot-payload writer was recovered at all; how a real game save fills the 0x800-byte slot payload and its header mirrors (+0x18..+0x1D, +0x20..+0x2B) is unknown.
Exact RAM mirror addresses (0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx) of all save buffers are unrecoverable from the workspace: decompiled.c names only _DAT_0800xxxx literal slots without values.
Meaning of global payload u16 at +0 (0xFFFF -> 0x0000 between captures) and of clamped fields at +2/+4/+8 is unknown; no save states exist in states/ to correlate with gameplay.
Seed literal _DAT_08087c84 is not printed in the decompilation; seed 0xAA55A5A5 is proven only by checksum inversion agreeing on both samples.
func_0x08092af0 (probable memcmp) and the lock/unlock thunks FUN_0808bbc8/FUN_0808bbd4 have no recovered bodies; their identification is by call shape only.
Header dword at +8 is 0xFFFFFFFF in the occupied global header but 0 in empty slots; no traced code writes that value.

Whether the 8-byte block reversal is an emulator .sav convention or the on-cartridge EEPROM bit order cannot be distinguished from workspace files alone; all interpretation must apply it consistently.
